annotation.evidence_span: MAY wait until an ack-eliciting packet has been received
annotation.interpretation_a: The endpoint is permitted to delay sending an ACK frame for non-ack-eliciting packets indefinitely, waiting for an ack-eliciting packet.
annotation.interpretation_b: The endpoint is permitted to delay sending an ACK frame for non-ack-eliciting packets, but only for a reasonable amount of time, and should not wait indefinitely.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' grants discretion, but the lack of a time limit creates ambiguity. A reasonable implementation could wait a short time, while another could wait indefinitely, both satisfying the 'MAY' condition. This difference in behaviour is material.
annotation.missing_information: The draft does not specify a maximum delay for waiting to bundle ACK frames. This missing constraint affects implementation, as different implementations could have vastly different waiting times.
